bios_heap.request_strategy: starts at 0x200000 and subtracts 0x400 until malloc succeeds; result and size become the game memory pool

proposal.method: reserve the top of the successfully allocated game pool before its custom allocator is initialized; store a persistent font pointer
proposal.load: read 35 sectors from DUMMY.DUM into the reserved block after CD initialization, then set font_ready

risks: Reducing the game pool by 70,656 bytes requires long-play and scene-transition regression tests.
Exact CD file/read wrappers and synchronization point must be traced before implementation.
The 0x80116000..0x80182068 gap contains referenced buffers and is not a safe extension area.
